query:
SELECT dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company, dp.jobTitle, dp.regionalRemit,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m.timeSlot ORDER BY m.timeSlot SEPARATOR ',') as bookedSlots
FROM delegateProfiles dp
LEFT JOIN meetings m ON m.attendeeId = dp.attendeeId AND m.status IN ('confirmed','suggested')
WHERE dp.attendeeId NOT IN ('9319401', '194295425320', '190937723960', '116903349643', '13454401')
GROUP BY dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company, dp.jobTitle, dp.regionalRemit
ORDER BY dp.lastName;
